L106: 【38†Inkigayo】 Chart winners (2026)
L107: ---
L108: The Inkigayo Chart is a 【39†music program】 【40†record chart】 on 【41†Seoul Broadcasting System】 (SBS) that gives an award to the best-performing 【42†single】 of the week in South Korea. The show aired every Sunday at 3:20 p.m. KST and was broadcast from the SBS Open Hall in 【43†Deungchon-dong】, 【44†Gangseo-gu, Seoul】.^{【45†[1]】}^{【46†[2]】} Every week, the show awards the best-performing 【42†single】 on the chart in the country during its live broadcast.
L109: The show has been hosted by 【47†EJ】, 【48†Shinyu】, and 【49†Yihyun】 since the beginning of 2026.^{【50†[3]】}
